summary: End-to-end testing of Hog Island (Phase 0-2). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass covering root health, guest login (success + 400 empty + 422 missing), score submission with rank/personal_best, and leaderboard (sort, limit, best-per-player, seeded TestHunter presence). Frontend: full happy-path verified via Playwright — landing prologue + guest login, main menu with all three cards + logout, leaderboard fetch shows seeded TestHunter, lore codex bestiary + shifthog detail modal open/close, game screen mounts with canvas + full HUD overlay (resume-play-button, hud-health-bar, hud-ammo-counter, hud-score, hud-wave) + abandon-hunt back to menu, logout returns to landing.
critical_code_review_comments: Score submission uses no auth token — any client can submit a score for any player_id/name. Fine for guest MVP, but consider validating the returned token from /auth/guest before /scores in future phases.
GameScreen.jsx is ~500 lines; consider splitting Player/Creature/Shooter/Island into separate files for maintainability.
Leaderboard aggregate does not tie-break by wave/survival_time when scores are equal — currently only by created_at. Acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Guest-only. Any name via guest-name-input + enter-island-button.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_Hunter and TEST_ScorePlayer guest players + 2 scores (500, 2500) for TEST_ScorePlayer. Also created 'PlaywrightHunter' via UI. No cleanup performed (leaderboard entries expected to persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes all under /api and pass; guest login trims/limits name to 20 chars; scores aggregate best-per-player; TestHunter (1500) is seeded. Pointer-lock FPS interaction cannot be automated in headless — only verify canvas + HUD mount as done here.
